name: Coach G
tagline: Connects your wearable first, then coaches your sport with a plan that keeps adjusting
description: The opening conversation is about plumbing: getting readings off your watch or ring and into the bot so it has something real to reason about. From then on you get a short morning read-out aimed at whatever you actually train for, and a programme that rewrites itself as your load and recovery numbers move.
author: Mike
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
